# Fields of the World — Global Data (beta)

> Beta release of the Fields of the World (FTW) global field-boundary
> predictions: per-UTM-zone GeoParquet field polygons for 2024 and 2025
> (fiboa/vecorel schema) and 2.5 m field/boundary-probability
> Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs for 2017–2025, derived from the TGE Labs
> Sentinel-2 quarterly cloudless mosaics. Hosted on Source Cooperative.

This file describes the dataset for machines and assistants.

Storage note: the public URL base is
`https://data.source.coop/ftw/global-data-beta/` (anonymous read), physically
backed by the S3 prefix
`s3://us-west-2.opendata.source.coop/ftw/global-data-beta/`.

## Layout

- `vector/{2024,2025}/utm{NN}.parquet` — field polygons, 54 UTM zones per year
- `raster/{2017..2025}/` — two-band (field, boundary probability) uint8 COGs, 2.5 m
- `index/vector.parquet`, `index/raster.parquet` — manifests (hrefs, sizes, bboxes)

## STAC catalog

- Root catalog: https://data.source.coop/ftw/global-data-beta/catalog.json
- The catalog is under construction; vector and raster collections land
  incrementally. See `AGENTS.md` beside this file for access guidance.
